guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Special (Marley) / Fender Stratocaster (Marvin)
guitar.notes: Marley famously played a Gibson Les Paul Special (and also Washburn/Ovation acoustics at times); this is reasonably well known, keeping medium confidence is fair given some variation.

tone.target: clean reggae skank with tight palm-muted snap
tone.profile: clean reggae skank with tight palm-muted snap
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain using a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with minimal compression and chorus/delay bypassed. The focus is on tight attack and room ambience.
